What is the Shaybah oil field?. Shaybah is an oil field in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, operated by the state oil company Saudi Aramco. Saudi Arabia has been in a conflict with the Iran-backed Houthis, a militant group based in Yemen. The kingdom has faced a series of attacks in recent months, and officials have not said who carried out each one. On Wednesday, October 21, 2026, a drone strike hit the Shaybah field early in the day and killed two people. Saudi Energy Ministry officials said oil production was not affected. No group has been confirmed as responsible for the airport attack. Together, the two attacks left three people dead.

What is the iPhone Duo?. The iPhone Duo is Apple's first foldable iPhone, a phone with a screen that opens up like a book. It went on sale on Friday, October 23, 2026. In the reported cases, the problem appears in a similar spot: the inner display along the hinge, with a bright line or lines running across the right side of the screen. One owner in Australia said the phone had been opened fewer than 20 times in about six hours when a crack formed along the hinge. Apple replaced that phone on the spot. Other buyers have shared photos and a short video showing similar damage. The cause has not been confirmed, and it is not clear how common the problem is. CNET bought an iPhone Duo in Louisville, Kentucky, and placed it in a testing machine that repeatedly opens and closes foldable phones. The machine measures the hinge and both screens over time. Apple has not publicly shared a figure for how long the iPhone Duo's hinge is expected to last. Most current foldable phones are rated for between 200,000 and 500,000 folds.
